name: Crusoe Cloud Network Maintenance in eu-iceland1-a

incident_updates.body:
Planned network maintenance in eu-iceland1-a has completed ahead of schedule. Work finished at 11:00 UTC, in advance of the 12:00 UTC window close.
All Front End (FE) Leaf switch upgrades are complete and all services in eu-iceland1-a are fully operational.
If you notice any issues following the maintenance, please contact support@crusoe.ai
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

Crusoe Cloud will be performing planned network maintenance to upgrade Front End (FE) Leaf switches across our global infrastructure on August 18 2026. This critical update addresses known software bugs and standardizes our network command-set, significantly improving long-term stability and incident response. This maintenance window duration is four hours [8am - 12 pm UTC]

During the maintenance window, some hypervisors in the eu-iceland1-a region will experience intermittent unavailability. This maintenance affects only a portion of the nodes, so please work with your CSM or contact the support team to see if your nodes are affected. We are proactively making reach outs to our customers who we believe will see some downtime. If you receive a notification from us or you believe your node will be affected, then we strongly recommend pausing or gracefully shutting down critical workloads during the window to prevent unexpected disruptions or data loss. 

All other services inside and outside the eu-iceland1-a region will remain operational. If you have questions regarding your specific workloads or notice persistent issues following a maintenance window, please reach out to support@crusoe.ai.
Maintenance window duration is changed and will be for 4 hours
